stage1.impression: A quiet, monochrome birch-and-snow mood that does set a black object against pale ground, but the whole frame is mid-grey and cool (nothing above ~197), so it reads as dull overcast CG rather than a luminous high-key editorial. The speaker looks set onto the snow, not standing in it: no contact shadow, no settling, and its smoked acrylic reads as flat dead grey-black with no tint or light passing through. One grass model repeated, a sliver of trunk on the left edge and stray twigs at the bottom say 'render'.

blocking_9: Snow must read as true high-key white (open snow median 222-238, no clipping) with a neutral-to-slightly-warm morning balance instead of the current blue-grey
The speaker must sit in the snow: a soft occlusion shadow and slight settling at the base, darkening the snow within ~3 cm by at least 40 levels
The smoked acrylic must show its tint and depth: transmitted light, a lit inner white lining and defined edges, not a uniform slab at lum 54
No visible repetition of ground scatter; grass from several models, fewer and clustered
Woodsmoke must read as smoke, distinct from the mist, as the concept's second element
Clean frame edges and foreground: no hard trunk sliver on the left edge, no random twigs in the bottom centre
